result.instructions: Tools for beehiiv, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many active subscribers does our newsletter have, and how many are premium?"; "List the 10 most recent published posts with their open-rate stats."; "Add tag 'vip' to the subscriber with this email address.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes beehiiv data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run beehiiv_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run beehiiv_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run beehiiv_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. beehiiv_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_publications
tools.title: List publications
tools.description: List the publications this API key can access. Use it first to find a publication id. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_publication
tools.title: Get a publication
tools.description: Get one publication: name, description, time zone, reply-to address and double opt-in setting. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}.

publication_id.description: Publication id (starts with pub_). Defaults to the publication this server is connected to.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscribers of a publication with status, tier, tags and optional stats. Filter by status or tier, or by exact email. Use cursor for the next page. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions.

publication_id.description: Publication id (starts with pub_). Defaults to the publication this server is connected to.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous reply's next_cursor (where supported).

expand.description: Extra objects to include on each subscription.

tools.name: beehiiv_create_subscription
tools.title: Add a subscriber
tools.description: Add an email address as a subscriber of a publication. Only add people who asked to join. Set reactivate_existing only when the person consented again. beehiiv API: POST /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions.

publication_id.description: Publication id (starts with pub_). Defaults to the publication this server is connected to.

reactivate_existing.description: Reactivate the address if it had unsubscribed. Use only with fresh consent.

tools.name: beehiiv_update_subscription
tools.title: Update a subscriber
tools.description: Change a subscriber's tier, newsletter lists, or unsubscribe them from the publication. Send only the fields to change. beehiiv API: PUT /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.

publication_id.description: Publication id (starts with pub_). Defaults to the publication this server is connected to.

unsubscribe.description: true unsubscribes the subscriber from the publication.

tools.name: beehiiv_add_subscription_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a subscriber
tools.description: Add tags to one subscriber. Tags group subscribers; they do not send anything. beehiiv API: POST /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/tags.

publication_id.description: Publication id (starts with pub_). Defaults to the publication this server is connected to.

tools.name: beehiiv_remove_subscription_tags
tools.title: Remove tags from a subscriber
tools.description: Remove tags from one subscriber. The tag stays on the publication. beehiiv API: DELETE /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/tags.

publication_id.description: Publication id (starts with pub_). Defaults to the publication this server is connected to.

tools.name: beehiiv_create_draft_post
tools.title: Create a draft post
tools.description: Create a draft post (newsletter issue) from HTML. The post is saved as a draft only: it is not scheduled or sent. Review it in beehiiv before you publish. beehiiv API: POST /v2/publications/{publicationId}/posts.

body_content.description: Post body as one HTML string (use inline styles).

publication_id.description: Publication id (starts with pub_). Defaults to the publication this server is connected to.
